headword: {販売促進費|はんばいそくしんひ}

definitions.explanation: Money spent on activities meant to boost sales — samples, in-store displays, campaigns, and giveaways. The full form of the everyday abbreviation {販促費|はんそくひ}.

examples.japanese: {販売促進費|はんばいそくしんひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
examples.english: We review the sales promotion expenses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年度|こんねんど}→今年度：28220_konnendo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{販売促進費|はんばいそくしんひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{前年|ぜんねん}→前年：23906_zennen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This fiscal year's sales promotion expenses are higher than last year's.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試食会|ししょくかい}→試食会：30210_shishokukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{販売促進費|はんばいそくしんひ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{処理|しょり}した→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧。
examples.english: The cost of the tasting event was handled as a sales promotion expense.

examples.japanese: {販売促進費|はんばいそくしんひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やして→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{結|むす}びつく→結びつく：13797_musubitsuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{限|かぎ}らない→限る：02033_kagiru⟧。
examples.english: Increasing promotional spending does not necessarily translate into sales right away.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧ (sales) + ⟦{促進|そくしん}→促進：05632_sokushin⟧ (promotion) + ⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ (expenses). The full form appears in accounting documents and formal reports; in conversation and internal email the clipped ⟦{販促費|はんそくひ}→販促費：30184_hansokuhi⟧ is far more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {販売促進費|はんばいそくしんひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計上|けいじょう}→計上：08006_keijou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to book promotional expenses
- {販売促進費|はんばいそくしんひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧: promotional budget
- {販売促進費|はんばいそくしんひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削|けず}る→削る：03922_kezuru⟧: to cut promotional spending

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{販促費|はんそくひ}→販促費：30184_hansokuhi⟧: the everyday abbreviation of this word
- ⟦{広告費|こうこくひ}→広告費：30159_koukokuhi⟧: advertising expenses — paid media, distinct from in-store promotion
- ⟦{交際費|こうさいひ}→交際費：19159_kousaihi⟧: entertainment expenses — hosting clients, booked separately
